changes.native_metadata: One statically initialized pthread mutex protects fixed native boundary/cache records. Guarded value snapshots and epoch/generation commits; no inspection, native output, or callbacks under the lock. Record admission reserves its entire boundary before output. Injected streams remain independently owned.
changes.presentation: External generations are checked before the unchanged-input return. Native/injected buffer transitions rebind presentation and preserve abandoned native boundaries. Submission rechecks resulting geometry before deferred escapes.
changes.warnings: One registry defines unchanged warning values and text; compile-time mask, capacity, uniqueness and disjoint-bank checks. Existing new/retry/coalescing rules retained.

initial_ci_failure.fix: The mask was parenthesized first, but the actual finding was the enum initializer; the enum expansion was then fixed and checked locally with the same rule and codet-header filter. No suppression or check weakening.
initial_ci_failure.admission_regression: Reserved records before separator I/O and removed the redundant later admission phase; a reentrant separator regression proves another record cannot suppress the body.

limitations: Blocking TTY output remains outside the bounded cancellation guarantee.
Emergency/standalone output remains best effort without EAGAIN waits; partial duplicates and conservative extra newlines remain possible.
The mutex protects metadata, not atomic whole-record byte output. Concurrent diagnostic bytes may interleave.
Injected ostream use and rdbuf replacement require caller synchronization; replacements are exercised between deliveries. Concurrent interactive cli_main invocations are not introduced.

The existing local SDK/Clang findings and compiler warning demotions are retained as explicit evidence; strict Ubuntu checks pass without weakening. One macOS ASan runtime child-side atfork failure is preserved with crash-report frames; no sanitizer setting or assertion was weakened.
Host cross-selection build/link/runtime excludes interposers and metrics but is not native PPC/Tiger verification. Native PPC/Tiger compiler, SDK and runtime are unavailable.
